contract.extension: Use an existing root sign certificate or the literal sign of a canonical rational, integer, one or positive shared constant before bounded rational recognition.
contract.existence: The independent child finite-real proof still precedes sign use. A sign alone does not prove the child is defined.
contract.scope: Keep lazy/unreduced rational preflight, rational recognition, exact-sign traversal and numeric domain refinement as existing fallbacks. No new graph traversal, coefficient copying or speculative budget is introduced.
contract.outputs: Former exhausted work may complete. Every definite fact, numerical error bound and typed invalid-domain result must agree; previously available proofs remain reusable.
contract.limits: Work units remain implementation-defined cooperative charges. No byte/time bound, new representation, public API or serialized format is introduced.
contract.priority: Completeness before performance or allocation savings; preserve all higher-priority exactness and prior completeness.
